facts.text: Audrey went on a hike last week and had an experience with a hummingbird.

evidence.quote: Last week I finally went on a hike and had this amazing experience with a hummingbird.

facts.text: Andrew found a new open space to hike nearby and feels it is a refreshing break.

evidence.quote: Well, good news - I found a new open space to hike nearby - feels so refreshing!

facts.text: Andrew usually tries to escape the city at least once a weekend for hiking.

evidence.quote: So I usually try to escape the city at least once a weekend - it's my much-needed break!

facts.text: Andrew finds nature therapeutic and describes it as peaceful and invigorating.

evidence.quote: Nature is so therapeutic for me. It's hard to put into words how great it feels to be surrounded by greenery or standing on top of a mountain breathing in the fresh air. So peaceful and invigorating.
